name: labs/e-lab-sfsu__robocam3.1
title: RoboCam 3.1 camera (robocam.camera:Camera)
intro: RoboCam 3.1 camera (robocam.camera:Camera), adapted from e-lab-sfsu/robocam3.1. It reads `running`, `resolution`, `supported_resolutions`, `capture_lock_timeouts` and 2 more; sets `exposure_us`, `gain`, `ae_enabled`, `hqi` and 3 more; runs `reset_capture_stats`. `reset_capture_stats`: reset the capture failure counters and return the zeroed counts. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
